What's inside

Built around history, impact, and legend.

Every box is put together to show off what made that month's car worth talking about — sometimes that's a car’s iconic aesthetic, the feats of engineering accomplished to create it, the twisting stories of their foundation, or the legend that it became. The contents of each box changes to match the unique identity of each car ranging from photography, prints, background pamphlets, or custom accessories to commemorate these cars — The car decides what it gets.

Why this exists

Pitwall is made by one person, researched and put together by hand, one car at a time. If a car doesn't have a real story behind it, it doesn't get a box.

More than a subscription box, it's closer to a magazine that only ever runs one story per issue — and takes its time telling it right.
